title: TypeSomething two-tone wordmark
description: A wordmark in two weights: a bold first half and a light second half in the brand colour, closed by an underscore cursor and an optional small icon. The second half can type itself out and erase on a loop.
notes: the tail uses primary as a text colour: on the TypeSomething theme it's a very light acid green, faithful but low-contrast on white
typing needs JavaScript (hydrate); the static HTML shows the full name
